findings.entity: olives poured from small glass bowl into jar (first pour)
findings.description: The small glass bowl contains only green olives (00:00-00:01.75), and only green olives are seen falling, yet dark purple/black olives appear in the jar from 00:00.50 onward; by 00:01.75 roughly half of the ~14 olives in the jar are dark purple. Green olives turn into dark olives with no visible source or mechanism.

findings.entity: olives in small glass bowl (second pour)
findings.description: After refilling from the steel bowl, which held only green olives, the small bowl shows only green olives at 00:06.00-00:06.50. At 00:06.75 several dark purple olives appear inside it with no visible addition.

findings.entity: dark olives in jar after second pour
findings.description: Before the second pour, the jar has about 8-9 dark olives of ~22. The small bowl poured in holds mostly green olives with only ~3 dark. By 00:09.00 the jar has roughly 20+ dark purple/grey olives and is mostly dark. That gain in dark olives is far larger than the dark olives the bowl visibly held.

After the hand scoops out olives, the steel bowl holds ~2 green olives at 00:05.25. That rises to ~3-4 at 00:06.00 and ~5 at 00:09.00 with no olives added. Brown nut/pit-like objects also appear; they could have been hidden under the olives, but no olive is ever put back.
